character_width.description: How many characters it takes before it line breaks it.

newline_limit.description: The limit of newlines between statements and declarations.

remove_empty_lines_at_start_or_end_of_bl.description: Remove blank lines immediately after the opening brace or before the closing brace of statement blocks, including procedures, if, for, and switch. Preserve blank lines between statements.

tabs_width.description: How many characters one tab represents

convert_do.description: Convert all do statements to brace blocks

preserve_do_mode.description: Select which do statement bodies are preserved; Guard permits return, break, and continue. Other do bodies are converted to brace blocks. convert_do overrides this setting

inline_single_stmt_case.description: When a case clause contains one statement allowed by inline_single_stmt_case_mode, inline the case and statement when they fit

inline_single_stmt_case_mode.description: Select which single statements may be inlined. Any preserves the legacy behavior

align_single_stmt_case.description: Align statements in consecutive inline single-statement cases while respecting character_width

spaces_around_colons.description: Put a space on both sides of a single colon during variable/field declaration, such as `foo : bar`

space_single_line_blocks.description: Put spaces around braces of single-line blocks: `{return 0}` => `{ return 0 }`

closing_brace_on_own_line.description: Put the closing brace of a multiline statement block on its own line

align_struct_fields.description: Align the types of struct fields so they all start at the same column

align_struct_values.description: Align the values of struct fields when assigning a struct value to a variable so they all start at the same column

align_struct_declarations.description: Align the struct declaration symbol in struct fields so they all start at the same column

align_constant_definitions.description: Align the :: or : of consecutive constant declarations so they all start at the same column. Constants separated by a blank line form separate alignment groups. Constants with type annotations are aligned separately from those without.

align_comments.description: Align trailing line comments on consecutive lines so they all start at the same column

multiline_composite_literals.description: Composite literals that span multiple lines are not forcibly inlined

preserve_struct_blank_lines.description: Preserve blank lines between struct fields, up to newline_limit
